column1: # Label cleaning, layer 1, cleaning version 3: strong cues that a run of single letters is a deliberate spelling, not
# an acronym (cleaning plan v7 "Spellings versus acronyms", class 3; training/cleaning.py). "position<TAB>pattern",
# one Python regular expression per line, matched case-insensitively:
#   before   searched in the run's previous SPELLING["cue_before"] words (letters and inner apostrophes; lowercased and
#            joined by single spaces), as a whole word or phrase (no letter directly on either side);
#   after    matched at the start of the text right after the run, after optional whitespace (an address).
# Weak cues ("called", "code") are not listed: they also precede acronyms ("a protocol called ...").
